content.text:
Perfect! I have found the root cause and the solution. The issue is a classic topology mismatch with storage provisioning.

**Summary of findings:**
- The `events-broker-0` pod is pinned to us-east-1b via node selector
- The PersistentVolume was created with node affinity restricted to us-east-1a
- This creates an impossible scheduling constraint

**Root cause:** The storage class was likely using `Immediate` volume binding mode (the default), which provisioned the volume without considering where the pod would be scheduled. According to the Kubernetes documentation [cite: concepts/storage/storage-classes#volume-binding-mode-0], "For storage backends that are topology-constrained and not globally accessible from all Nodes in the cluster, PersistentVolumes will be bound or provisioned without knowledge of the Pod's scheduling requirements. This may result in unschedulable Pods."

The solution is to use `WaitForFirstConsumer` binding mode [cite: concepts/storage/storage-classes#volume-binding-mode-1], which "will delay the binding and provisioning of a PersistentVolume until a Pod using the PersistentVolumeClaim is created. PersistentVolumes will be selected or provisioned conforming to the topology that is specified by the Pod's scheduling constraints."

Let me update the ticket with the resolution:

input.note:
CAUSE: The events-broker-0 pod has a node selector requiring us-east-1b, but the PersistentVolume was provisioned with node affinity restricting it to us-east-1a, creating an impossible scheduling constraint.

EVIDENCE: Pod showed "Unschedulable" with "3 node(s) had volume node affinity conflict" - the volume pvc-3f9c2e71-8a4d-4b6e-9c15-0d7e2a8b41f6 has pv_node_affinity "topology.kubernetes.io/zone in [us-east-1a]" while the pod has node selector "topology.kubernetes.io/zone: us-east-1b".

FIX: Reconfigure the storage class for the events-broker StatefulSet to use `WaitForFirstConsumer` volume binding mode instead of the default `Immediate` mode [cite: concepts/storage/storage-classes#volume-binding-mode-0, concepts/storage/storage-classes#volume-binding-mode-1]. This ensures volumes are provisioned with topology awareness of where the pod will actually run. You'll need to delete the existing PVC and StatefulSet, update the storage class binding mode, then recreate them.
